visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pink-haired cartoon girl with star-shaped pupils gazes longingly at a large, layered chocolate cake. The background is a soft pink with floating bubble-like circles. (2) Close-up view of a slice of tiramisu-style cake on a plate with sparkles surrounding it. (3) The girl, now against a yellow background, holds her face in excitement as she looks at the cake. (4) A sudden pink blur sweeps across the screen. (5) The girl looks down in shock at an empty table; her eyes are wide and dark. (6) A yellow-clothed boy sits at the table eating the cake with a fork while looking at his smartphone. The girl watches him with a furious, strained expression. (7) The girl screams dramatically against a purple background with vertical action lines. (8) The girl is shown crying and sobbing on the floor next to a few remaining crumbs. (9) A match lights a white candle in a dimly lit setting. (10) The girl, wearing a black mourning hat and veil, kneels in a room filled with candles, praying before a framed photo of the cake. (11) A close-up of a smartphone screen showing the 'invideo' app interface as someone types a long prompt about a tribute video for a disappeared cake. (12) A finger presses a blue 'Generate' button. (13) A stylized, high-detail anime sequence begins, showing a realistic cake on a wooden table, followed by a close-up of a pink-haired anime girl with detailed tears running down her face. (14) The anime sequence shows a white plate with only crumbs remaining. (15) Back to the cartoon style: the boy enters the room holding a new piece of cake with a happy expression, while the girl remains in her mourning pose and shushes him. (16) A final title card appears with text overlays on a dark background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: invideo. (2) [Subtitle]: Hey invideo, make an animated tribute video for my chocolate cake that disappeared... before my fork even hit the plate. (3) [Slogan]: Generate. (4) [Subtitle]: It was here just moments past, my chocolate bliss too sweet to last. (5) [Subtitle]: Now the plate is all I see, empty, cold... it stares at me. (6) [Subtitle]: Farewell, sweet crumb my fleeting friend, (7) [Slogan]: Turn your feelings into stories with invideo. (8) [Logo]: invideo.
